description: Schema-decidable cases for the cross-model comparison contract (S10). The semantic invariants the minimal JSON schema engine cannot express (verdict/reason consistency, winner-capability of the preferred candidate, the absolute security exclusion, re-derived comparability flags, the supported instruction-overhead ratio, the authority-free posture, the live-evidence authorization rule, the closed gate sequence, the adapter-boundary rule) are enforced by semanticComparisonIssues in scripts/tools/validate-cross-model-comparison.mjs and covered in tests/vnext/cross-model-eval.test.mjs. Valid cases are honest engine outputs across all three verdict classes; invalid cases are tampered variants, each failing for a named reason. Each case names the contract schema for the generic fixture validator; the S10-specific fail-closed semantics are enforced by scripts/tools/validate-cross-model-comparison.mjs. Only schema-decidable negative cases live in this shared file; the fail-closed semantic invariants (winner capability, dominance, the absolute security exclusion, comparability flags, the overhead ratio, the gate sequence, the adapter boundary) are exercised as tamper cases in tests/vnext/cross-model-eval.test.mjs and by scripts/tools/validate-cross-model-comparison.mjs.
